description.value: Coco Grill is a floating restaurant at Fisherman's Wharf on Victoria's Inner Harbour, specializing in tropical-influenced seafood with an Asian fusion twist. It offers patio seating overlooking the water — a scenic and distinctive stop for cyclists riding the Dallas Road waterfront. The wharf setting makes it one of the more atmospheric dining options in downtown Victoria.
